key.name: overlay-enabled
key.summary: Show the lyric overlay while a song with timed lyrics plays

key.name: font-size
key.summary: Constant lyric text size in pixels; long lines wrap naturally without shrinking

key.name: font-family
key.summary: Font family; empty means the desktop interface font

key.name: font-italic
key.summary: Draw the lyric line in italic

key.name: text-furigana
key.summary: Show hiragana furigana readings above kanji in Japanese lyrics

key.name: lyric-max-lines
key.summary: Line wrapping behavior inside the lyric width: 0 (Auto, default) keeps a constant font size and wraps evenly; 1–4 cap lines by gently shrinking overflowing lines before wrapping

key.name: score-enabled
key.summary: Show the separate floating white-paper piano lead sheet window while a song plays

key.name: score-scale-snap
key.summary: How tightly vocal notes snap to the song's scale: soft keeps held chromatic notes, strict snaps every note, off keeps raw pitches

key.name: score-harmony
key.summary: Optional diatonic 3rd harmony guide notes (blue above, green below on white paper) for practicing harmonies

key.name: score-voices
key.summary: Which extracted vocal parts to display and play when a song has harmonizing voices: both (upper stems up, lower stems down), top, or bottom

key.name: score-note-names
key.summary: Label shown below each note on the lead sheet: note names (G4), scale degrees (1–7), or off

key.name: score-height
key.summary: Legacy staff height setting kept for schema compatibility

key.name: score-background-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the white sheet-music paper background

key.name: score-box
key.summary: Floating piano lead sheet box center and size as fractions of its monitor's work area

key.name: score-box-monitor
key.summary: Monitor index of the floating piano lead sheet; -1 follows the primary monitor

key.name: score-bars-per-system
key.summary: Measures shown per staff line on the piano lead sheet: 0 auto-reflows to fill window width at the chosen zoom, 1–12 pins a fixed count

key.name: score-rows
key.summary: Legacy rows-per-page setting kept for schema compatibility; visible rows now always auto-fill window height

key.name: score-scale
key.summary: Uniform staff engraving zoom for the piano lead sheet (0.6 to 3.5, preserves printed proportions)

key.name: score-always-on-top
key.summary: Keep the standard Piano Lead Sheet window above other desktop windows

key.name: score-spacing
key.summary: Natural horizontal measure spacing on the piano lead sheet: compact, normal, or spacious

key.name: score-paging
key.summary: Page turn behavior on the floating lead sheet: page flips cleanly to the next page when finished, scroll shifts up one row at a time

key.name: score-click-action
key.summary: Legacy click-action setting kept for schema compatibility; plain left-click on the standard Lead Sheet window keeps normal OS focus

key.name: score-show-header
key.summary: Show the top header strip on the piano lead sheet

key.name: score-header-title
key.summary: Show the song title in the lead sheet header

key.name: score-header-key
key.summary: Show the active musical key in the lead sheet header

key.name: score-header-time
key.summary: Show the time signature in the lead sheet header

key.name: score-header-bpm
key.summary: Show the tempo (BPM) in the lead sheet header

key.name: score-header-clef
key.summary: Show the octave clef indicator (8vb) in the lead sheet header

key.name: score-header-bars
key.summary: Show the visible bar range (Bars 1–12/48) in the lead sheet header

key.name: score-header-page
key.summary: Show the page counter (Page 1/4) in the lead sheet header

key.name: score-show-measure-numbers
key.summary: Show measure numbers above barlines on the piano lead sheet

key.name: score-show-chords
key.summary: Show chord symbols above the staff on the piano lead sheet

key.name: score-show-lyrics
key.summary: Show aligned lyric words beneath the staff on the piano lead sheet

key.name: score-show-playhead
key.summary: Show the moving red playhead hairline on the piano lead sheet

key.name: score-show-active-measure
key.summary: Show yellow active-measure and active-note highlighting on the piano lead sheet

key.name: score-show-snap-moves
key.summary: Show a ghost dot, vertical arrow, and pitch-move label whenever Scale Snap pulls a detected note onto the song's scale

key.name: text-color
key.summary: Letter color preset

key.name: text-custom-color
key.summary: Custom letter color as #rrggbb; empty uses text-color

key.name: text-border
key.summary: Concentric contrast borders around letters: none, 1 to 4 solid rings (single, double, triple, quad), or a fused inner body with feathered halo (glow)

key.name: text-border-cloud
key.summary: Add a soft dark Gaussian backing cloud behind the border rings

key.name: text-border-1-color
key.summary: Ring 1 (innermost) border color as #rrggbb; empty uses automatic contrast

key.name: text-border-1-width
key.summary: Ring 1 border thickness as a fraction of font size (em); 0 uses the preset default

key.name: text-border-2-color
key.summary: Ring 2 border color as #rrggbb; empty uses automatic contrast

key.name: text-border-2-width
key.summary: Ring 2 border thickness as a fraction of font size (em); 0 uses the preset default

key.name: text-border-3-color
key.summary: Ring 3 border color as #rrggbb; empty uses automatic contrast

key.name: text-border-3-width
key.summary: Ring 3 border thickness as a fraction of font size (em); 0 uses the preset default

key.name: text-border-4-color
key.summary: Ring 4 (outermost) border color as #rrggbb; empty uses automatic contrast

key.name: text-border-4-width
key.summary: Ring 4 border thickness as a fraction of font size (em); 0 uses the preset default

key.name: text-backdrop
key.summary: Background plate behind the lyric: none, snug rounded bar behind text, or full bar

key.name: text-backdrop-color
key.summary: Backdrop plate color as #rrggbb

key.name: text-backdrop-opacity
key.summary: Backdrop plate opacity

key.name: text-align
key.summary: Horizontal alignment of the lyric across its box

key.name: transition
key.summary: Line transition: brief 0.15 s fade-in or instant cut

key.name: pitch-enabled
key.summary: Show the pitch panel, a trace of the sung pitch from the microphone, while a song plays

key.name: pitch-dock
key.summary: Where the pitch panel sits: against a side of the lyric box, or separate (pitch-box)

key.name: pitch-docked-height
key.summary: Height of the pitch panel docked above or below the lyric, as a fraction of the work area height

key.name: pitch-docked-width
key.summary: Width of the pitch panel docked left or right of the lyric, as a fraction of the work area width

key.name: pitch-box
key.summary: Separate pitch panel center and size as fractions of its monitor's work area

key.name: pitch-box-monitor
key.summary: Monitor index of the separate pitch panel; -1 follows the primary monitor

key.name: pitch-range
key.summary: Notes shown: fixed from pitch-range-bottom to pitch-range-top, or pitch-follow-span semitones following the voice

key.name: pitch-range-bottom
key.summary: Lowest note of the fixed range as a MIDI note number (48 is C3, 60 is middle C)

key.name: pitch-range-top
key.summary: Highest note of the fixed range as a MIDI note number (72 is C5); at least 6 above the bottom

key.name: pitch-follow-span
key.summary: Semitones shown when the range follows the voice

key.name: pitch-window-seconds
key.summary: Seconds of singing across the panel

key.name: pitch-time-in-silence
key.summary: The trace keeps scrolling through silences; off, it stops 0.4 s into a pause

key.name: pitch-line-width
key.summary: Pitch trace thickness in pixels

key.name: pitch-line-color
key.summary: Pitch trace color as #rrggbb

key.name: pitch-background-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the panel's black background

key.name: pitch-labels
key.summary: Which note lines carry their name; names that would collide give way to scale notes

key.name: pitch-label-size
key.summary: Note name size in pixels

key.name: pitch-scale
key.summary: Scale whose note lines stand out: detected from the song's audio, fixed (pitch-scale-root, pitch-scale-type), or none

key.name: pitch-scale-root
key.summary: Root of the fixed scale as a pitch class (0 is C, 7 is G)

key.name: pitch-scale-type
key.summary: Type of the fixed scale

key.name: pitch-show-key
key.summary: Name the scale in the panel's corner

key.name: pitch-readout
key.summary: Where the current note shows: a column at a side, a corner over the trace, or nowhere

key.name: pitch-readout-size
key.summary: Current note height as a fraction of the panel height

key.name: pitch-readout-cents
key.summary: Show how many cents the voice is off the current note

key.name: pitch-rate
key.summary: Pitch analyses per second

key.name: pitch-microphone
key.summary: PipeWire node name of the microphone; empty means the system's default input

key.name: pitch-echo-cancel
key.summary: Subtract what the speakers play from the microphone, so the trace follows the singer instead of the song

key.name: box
key.summary: Overlay box center and size as fractions of its monitor's work area

key.name: box-monitor
key.summary: Monitor index of the box; -1 follows the primary monitor

key.name: tray-mode
key.summary: How the standalone desktop overlay exposes its status indicator: auto (system tray, adding a panel button when the panel hides AppIndicators), sni only, panel-button only, or both

key.name: tray-button-right-offset
key.summary: Distance in pixels from the right edge of the primary monitor to the standalone panel status button; -1 places it automatically
